rur.translation: abbr. reliably unreliable 确实不可靠的可靠性

rural.definition:
a. living in or characteristic of farming or country life
a. of or relating to the countryside as opposed to the city
rural.translation:
a. 乡下的, 田园的, 乡村风味的
[法] 农村的, 乡村的, 有关农业的

rural free delivery.translation: n. 乡村地区免费邮递

rural-urban migration.translation: [法] 农村向城市移民, 农村人口流入城市

rurales.definition:
n. pl. The gossamer-winged butterflies; a family of small
   butterflies, including the hairstreaks, violets, and theclas.
rurales.translation: n. 墨西哥乡村骑警队

ruralism.definition: n. a rural idiom or expression

ruralist.definition: n. an advocate of rural living
ruralist.translation: n. 田园生活者, 精于农村事务的人

ruralists.definition:
plural of ruralist
n. an advocate of rural living
ruralists.translation: (ruralist 的复数) n. 田园生活者, 精于农村事务的人

rurality.definition: n. a rural characteristic or trait
rurality.translation: n. 田园风味, 田园生活, 田园风光

ruralize.definition:
v. t. To render rural; to give a rural appearance to.
v. i. To become rural; to go into the country; to rusticate.
ruralize.translation:
vt. 使成田园风味, 使农村化
vi. 在农村生活

ruralized.translation: v. 使农村化, 在农村居住( ruralize的过去式和过去分词 )

ruralizes.translation: 使农村化, 在农村居住( ruralize的第三人称单数 )

ruralizing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Ruralize
ruralizing.translation: v. 使农村化, 在农村居住( ruralize的现在分词 )

rurally.translation: adv. 乡下地；农村风味地

ruralness.definition: n. The quality or state of being rural.

rurban.translation: a. 靠近都市之农村的

ruridecanal.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a rural dean; as, a ruridecanal
   district; the ruridecanal intellect.
ruridecanal.translation: a. 乡村教区司铎的, <主英> 乡村主任牧师的

rurigenous.translation: a. 乡下出生的, 住在乡下的

rurik.translation: 留里克(?～879)，诺夫哥罗德城主(862)和俄国留里克王朝(862～1598)的创建者

ruritan.translation: n. <美>鲁里坦俱乐部成员(一美国全国服务性团体,旨在加强相互联系及友谊,为公众福利服务)

ruritania.definition: n an imaginary kingdom in central Europe; often used as a scene for intrigue and romance
ruritania.translation: n. 鲁里坦尼亚王国,浪漫国

ruritanian.definition:
n an imaginary inhabitant of Ruritania
a of or pertaining to or characteristic of Ruritania (or any other imaginary country)
ruritanian.translation: a. 理想王国的, 想像中之王国的, 对王室持浪漫主义观念的

ruritanians.definition:
plural of Ruritanian
n an imaginary inhabitant of Ruritania
a of or pertaining to or characteristic of Ruritania (or any other imaginary country)
ruritanians.translation: (Ruritanian 的复数) adj.理想王国的, 想像中之王国的, 对王室持浪漫主义观念的
